scope: Target-reader experience calibration for 一命过桥 and closely related project validation; contains no known failure locations or answer-key excerpts.
source: Explicit target-reader feedback on the current manuscript plus project-level stated quality goal.
quality_goal: Highly immersive commercial-literary Chinese fiction with strong page-turn desire, lived emotional scenes, human speech texture, meaningful suspense pull and felt climax escalation.

dramatization: High-stakes scenes should feel lived rather than read like efficient event notes.
Minimal dialogue is welcome when specific physical pressure, relationship history, silence, perception or irreversible action makes the omitted emotion unavoidable.
Across a manuscript, repeated terse question-answer-command surfaces should not dominate unrelated emotional scenes even when each scene is locally logical.
Do not fix thin scenes with decorative description, generic gestures or lyrical padding; use scene-specific resistance, behavior, perception and consequence.
speech: Live dialogue should prioritize what the speaker most urgently needs now, not what the reader needs summarized.
Shared context should usually be omitted or fragmented unless the speaker has a real reason to restate it.
Prefer plausible interruption, inference, partial answer and reaction over polished multi-fact packets in live pressure.
Formal testimony, briefing, public persuasion and deliberate confession may be complete when the scene supports uninterrupted delivery.
suspense: A mystery must create desire to know the answer, not merely support a coherent theory.
Clues should change prediction, fear, hope, relationship interpretation or decision pressure.
If revealing the answer early would leave most of the scene's pull intact because danger/action alone carries interest, the mystery itself has weak curiosity charge.
Fair hypothesis-building is necessary but not sufficient.
climax: Structural escalation must produce a felt rise in pressure or meaning, not only remove options on paper.
Major climax beats should not read as similarly weighted event units.
A quiet irreversible choice may be the highest peak; spectacle is not required.
Aftershock and emotional consequence matter as much as physical resolution.
reader_propulsion: Event density is not page-turn compulsion.
The reader should repeatedly gain a stronger reason to continue: anticipation, dread, emotional debt, reward, question ownership or consequential choice.
Localized quiet is acceptable; sustained flatness is not.

false_positive_controls: Do not require every scene to be loud, long or highly descriptive.
Do not penalize concise dialogue merely for being concise.
Do not demand cliffhangers in a complete ending.
Do not imitate the wording, characters, plot or recognizable style of source novels.
Do not use a numeric score as a standalone gate.
